title: readywhen
lede: readywhen is an assistant you reach only by email: send it a follow-up job and it drafts the message, holds it for your approval, then watches the thread for an answer.

points: Jobs are plain emails to assistant@readywhen.ai, such as chasing an unpaid invoice, holding a draft to an investor, or nudging someone if they have not replied by a set day.
Drafts go out from the user's own address, and only after the user replies "send".
When no answer arrives, it reports back and offers to send another nudge.
It can also list everything the user is still waiting on, and the team says it connects to more than 1,000 tools.
There is no app, dashboard or account setup; the email address is the whole interface.

sections.text: People who run client, investor and contract work from their inbox and lose track of who still owes them a reply.
